Sample beetle phylogenies (15-taxon subset)

Source: R/data.R
sample_trees.Rd

A named list (the same structure returned by read_trees()) of five phylogenetic trees from a dung beetle phylogenomic study, Lopes et al. (2024), pruned to 15 taxa for compact demonstration of the phylorug workflow. The trees are already rooted, outgroup-removed, and tip labels translated from museum codes to species names. Users can select a backbone tree and comparison trees, then pass them directly to check_taxa(), node_presence_matrix(), and plot_phylorug().

Usage

sample_trees

Format

A named list of 5 objects of class "phylo", each with 15 tips. Node labels contain support values: SH-aLRT/UFBoot2 for IQ-TREE trees and local posterior probability for ASTRAL trees.

Source

Lopes, F., Gunter, N., Gillett, C. P. D. T., et al. (2024). From museum drawer to tree: Historical DNA phylogenomics clarifies the systematics of rare dung beetles (Coleoptera: Scarabaeinae) from museum collections. PLOS ONE, 19(12), e0309596. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0309596

Details

The five trees represent independent phylogenomic analyses of the same set of taxa using different inference methods and data types:

70p_uce

IQ-TREE maximum likelihood analysis of ultraconserved element (UCE) data. Recommended as the backbone tree.

70p_partition_entropy

IQ-TREE maximum likelihood analysis of partitioned sequence data.

70p_ghost

IQ-TREE GHOST heterotachous model on partitioned data.

70p_ASTRAL_uce

ASTRAL coalescent analysis of UCE gene trees.

70p_ASTRAL_partition_entropy

ASTRAL coalescent analysis of partitioned gene trees.

Examples

# Core pipeline:
backbone <- sample_trees[["70p_uce"]]
others   <- sample_trees[names(sample_trees) != "70p_uce"]

# Optional: diagnose taxon overlap
check_taxa(backbone, others)
#> All 4 comparison trees share the same 15 taxa as the backbone.
#> [1] TRUE
#> attr(,"diagnostics")
#>                     comparison    status n_taxa missing extra
#> 1 70p_ASTRAL_partition_entropy identical     15              
#> 2               70p_ASTRAL_uce identical     15              
#> 3                    70p_ghost identical     15              
#> 4        70p_partition_entropy identical     15              

npm <- node_presence_matrix(backbone, others, support_col = c(1, 2))
tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".pdf")
plot_phylorug(backbone, npm, file = tmp)
unlink(tmp)
